purpose: Refine existing classic mobile UI while preserving native equipment and gameplay

assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 9-slice border texture for a retro Lineage-inspired mobile RPG UI, not a mockup. Input image 1 is the old UI frame to redraw. Redraw it as one perfectly square 1024x1024 ornamental frame with a genuinely TRANSPARENT empty center and transparent outside. Keep its classic dark medieval fantasy, aged silver metal craftsmanship, but radically refine the cheap pixelated twisty edges: precise carved silver corner fittings, subtle warm champagne-brass hairline inlay, soot-dark engraved recesses, lightly worn brushed metal edge highlights. Overall charcoal, smoked umber, antique silver, restrained warm gold, no olive-green cast. The frame must sit square and flush to the image edges with consistent 48 pixel border thickness; contained corner ornaments occupy at most 96x96 pixels. All four straight edge middle sections must be simple straight continuous rails, designed to stretch horizontally/vertically without visible decoration distortion. Four finely sculpted leaf-and-scroll corner details, no center crest, no medallions, no protruding spikes. Orthographic front view, balanced soft top-left lighting, high craft detail but quiet contrast. No labels, no text, no letters, no close button, no icons, no internal inventory slots, no characters, no background art, no watermark, no checkerboard drawn into the pixels. Exactly one usable frame asset, not a contact sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production inventory-slot background tile for a classic medieval dark fantasy RPG mobile game UI, no mockup. Create a perfectly square empty recessed item slot, orthographic front view, full bleed, opaque. Center is empty charcoal-black leather with almost imperceptible fine grain, completely unobstructed and very dark for a small colorful item sprite to sit over it. Thin aged dark-silver beveled metal perimeter, hairline muted champagne-brass inlay, tiny precisely engraved corner joinery. The outer rim occupies 8 percent of width on each side; center 84 percent remains vacant. Fine polished wear only on upper left edges, rich shadow on lower right interior creates physical inset depth. Palette charcoal black #131315, smoke umber #272320, aged pewter #79736a, restrained antique brass #998263. Premium tactile craftsmanship with the charm of a late-1990s Korean PC fantasy RPG, crisp edge geometry, restrained highlights, no olive green, no bright yellow, no neon, no flat vector shapes, no huge glossy gradient. Exactly one slot, no grid, no second inset box, no ornament occupying the center, no icon, no item, no text or lettering, no glow, no watermark.

packaging: Runtime WebP copies resized and encoded from generated originals; no recoloring or painting during packaging. Original PNG alpha preserved.
